name: Narrator
text: Once upon a time, rabbits lived together in the deep woods.

name: Narrator
text: None of them ever wondered where they had come from, or why they had come to live there.

name: Narrator
text: Then one day, a rabbit began to have doubts.

speaker: left
name: Pink Bunny
text: Why doesn't our king allow us to go outside the forest? I've heard there are so many exciting things and so many other species out there.

name: Narrator
text: Whenever that rabbit brought up these doubts to the elders, no one would give a straight answer.

name: Narrator
text: Not even the rabbit’s own older sister, who guarded the path leading outside.

name: Narrator
text: The rabbit tried to sneak out multiple times, only to get scolded by the older sister every single time.

name: Narrator
text: Eventually, the rabbit put those doubts aside and strove to become a great warrior instead.

name: Narrator
text: The rabbit reasoned that since they only turned it back saying the outside world was dangerous, they would surely let it go once it grew strong enough.

name: Narrator
text: But when the rabbit tried to venture out yet again, it was defeated in a duel against the older sister.

name: Narrator
text: Overwhelmed with frustration, the rabbit trained so fiercely that it ended up slipping and tumbling down into the deep, dark woods.

speaker: left
name: Pink Bunny
text: Ouch... Where am I? I've never seen this place before. Did I fall too deep?
